## Before review

- [ ] `cargo build --workspace`, `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --all --check` pass, as `CONTRIBUTING.md` asks.
- [ ] Every commit message stands on its own and names no chat, plan or numbered item a reader here cannot see.
- [ ] On a first change here, the contributor-agreement sentence from `CONTRIBUTING.md` is posted as a comment on this pull request.
